units.source_text: 岛村感冒总不见好，这会儿让冷空气从不通气的鼻孔一下子冲到了脑门心，

en.t: Shimamura's cold would not get better, and just then cold air suddenly rushed through his blocked nostrils up into the center of his forehead,

units.source_text: 清鼻涕簌簌地流个不停，好像把脏东西都给冲了出来。

en.t: Clear mucus kept streaming out, as if all the dirt inside had been washed away.
